messages:
Matt: quick sync before we update the RFC. proposing adapters return a tiny status instead of Optional<Route> so we can signal 'soft fallback' semantics.

Sara: +1. right now nil==hard fallback and we lose "acceptable but degraded" cases.

Jin: what does the minimal shape look like? we need to keep allocations tiny at 100k qps.

Matt: proposal: policy.evaluate(...) -> { status: accept|soft_fallback|hard_fallback, candidate?: Route, reason_enum?: string, priority_delta?: int } (flat, small ints)

Ben: runtime can still use candidate for soft_fallback but tag telemetry and maybe add a penalty. avoids silent quality drops.

Carla: enforce a small enum set for reasons (capacity_limited, latency_degraded, precision_tradeoff). allow optional debug string but not for metrics.

Sara: ops asks for metric soft_fallback_rate per tenant/model/region with alert >5% for 5m on prod tiers.

Jin: perf: status a byte, enum id small int, priority_delta small int. no new heap for hot path if we reuse existing candidate pointer.

Ben: migration path? most adapters are v1 and return Optional<Route>.

Matt: runtime will support both. v1 -> implicit hard_fallback via shim. v2 adapters can emit soft_fallback. add compatibility tests.

Carla: tests: ordering when soft_fallbacks present; sim to detect thrash; canary to Dedicated first.

Sara: plan: I'll prototype v2 adapter types + shim tests (Thu) and open PR.

Jin: I'll add telemetry fields and sim harness (Fri).

Ben: I'll update docs and migration checklist (Mon).

Carla: mapping doc of current adapter return paths -> enums posted by EOD.

Matt: one open question: should we expose priority_delta so tenant SLA can override ordering?

Jin: propose optional priority_delta:int (negative to promote, positive to deprioritize). default 0 for accept, maybe +10 for soft_fallback. runtime honors SLA==strict override.

Sara: keep priority_delta optional and small. runtime ignores it when SLA is strict.

ops-bot: ticket INF-1427 created: "policy-engine adapter v2 + soft_fallback rollout" assigned to @Sara @Jin @Carla @Ben.

Matt: consensus to include reason_enum + optional priority_delta. Sara ping when PR is ready and I'll update RFC.

Sara: will do, thanks!"
